title: Second Method Screening - M7-M11 (deployable / normal-only / training-free)
paper_stage: 方法发现 / Method Discovery（继 9A「无方法晋级」之后的第二批候选海选）
question: 在 9A 无方法晋级后，是否存在 deployable / normal-only / training-free / PatchCore-compatible 的第二批候选（M7-M11）能改善 robustness-preservation trade-off？

epsilon.note: EPS_DP = 5A-H frozen preservation band; EPS_RZ = 7A-O Tier-A robustness band

candidate_constraints_frozen: normal-only: every parameter/statistic estimated from train/good images only
deployable: no oracle / no test defect mask / no test anomaly labels
training-free: no gradient training, no learned fusion
no parameter selection from 9B target results

frozen_pipeline.bank_coreset_knn_illumination_scoring: identical to 5A-H / 7A-O / 9A path (coreset 0.1, kNN 9, 4 frozen photometric shifts)
frozen_pipeline.insertion_points: layer2 before concat; layer3 before upsample (identical to all historical alpha-IN work)

normal_only_illumination_sensitivity_fro.name: s_c (per-channel illumination sensitivity)
normal_only_illumination_sensitivity_fro.estimated_on: train/good images only (bottle 189 / cable 204), the 4 frozen shifts
normal_only_illumination_sensitivity_fro.definition: s_c = mean over (train image, shift) of mean_spatial |pooled_feature(T(x))_c - pooled_feature(x)_c|
normal_only_illumination_sensitivity_fro.feature_space: after PatchcoreModel.feature_pooler (AvgPool2d(3,1,1)), per layer (layer2 C=512, layer3 C=1024)
normal_only_illumination_sensitivity_fro.cached: results/experiment_9b_screening/cache/illum_sensitivity_<cat>_seed0_<hash>.npz (reused by M8/M9/M11; ONE estimation per category)

M7_layer_selective_normalization.mechanism: per-layer independent alpha-IN strength, alpha_L2 != alpha_L3 (existing FAlphaDualLayerPatchcoreModel, no new code)
M7_layer_selective_normalization.preregistered_direction: 1H: layer2 is the sensitive layer for bottle/cable defects (preferred_sensitive_layer=layer2); Q2: residual in L2 slot helps (+0.5793 d-prime), in L3 slot hurts. Prediction: alpha_L2-heavy > alpha_L3-heavy.

M8_normal_only_channel_gate.mechanism: soft per-layer per-channel gate from normal-only s_c; F'_c = (1-a_c)*F_c + a_c*IN(F)_c
M8_normal_only_channel_gate.weight_map: a_c = clip(a_bar + beta * z_c, 0, 1), z_c = (s_c - mean_c s)/(std_c s + 1e-8) per layer
M8_normal_only_channel_gate.a_bar_rationale: 0.25 = 6A/6B historical knee (alpha_F=0.25), chosen from HISTORY before any 9B result; beta=0 reduces exactly to uniform alpha=0.25

M9_soft_channel_weighting.mechanism: mild alternative to M3 hard projection: keep all directions, re-weight channels by absolute normal-only sensitivity
M9_soft_channel_weighting.weight_map: w_c = clip((s_c / p90_c(s))^gamma, 0, 1) per layer (scale-free absolute map, NOT mean-preserving)
M9_soft_channel_weighting.note: gamma=2 sharpens emphasis on high-sensitivity channels; average strength is data-determined (recorded in gate statistics)

M10_original_robust_concat.mechanism: dual branch = fixed concat(original, robust) with pre-registered ratio gamma
M10_original_robust_concat.EQUIVALENT_HISTORICAL_ASSET: 7A-O Family B dual_step(gamma) = concat([F, gamma*IN_hat(F)]) -> identical frozen definition
M10_original_robust_concat.decision: REUSE - 0 GPU (no re-run); channel dim doubles 1536->3072 (7A-O recorded ~5.1 GB peak, 2 OOM events at 3 workers)

M11_layer_x_channel_gate.mechanism: M7 (layer-specific strength) x M8 (normal-only channel gate): per-layer base strength (a_bar_L2, a_bar_L3) = (0.50, 0.00) + per-layer channel gate
M11_layer_x_channel_gate.rationale: 1H layer-specific evidence (layer2 sensitive) + M8 channel evidence; no learned network, no target-driven gate

sanity_required: S1 alpha=0 / gate=0 strictly reduces to original PatchcoreModel.generate_embedding (bit-exact)
S2 tensor shapes unchanged (embedding 1536 x 32 x 32 for non-concat candidates)
S3 no NaN / Inf in embeddings, gates, scores
S4 gate range legal (0 <= a_c <= 1) and constant-gate equivalence: constant a_c equals uniform alpha
S5 no defect GT / test data used in fit (s_c from train/good only; n_train recorded)
S6 M7 uniform setting (alpha_L2 == alpha_L3) equals historical uniform alpha baseline
S7 M8/M9/M11 gate statistics independent of test data (train-only cache hash recorded)
S8 baseline equivalence on GPU smoke: bottle seed0 (alpha=0) == historical 5A-H B0 bit-exact
S9 per-unit row counts match (183 bottle / 402 cable)
S10 no failed unit silently excluded

budget_estimate_frozen.hard_stop: if measured ETA > 45 min, keep only the core configs and report

exit_conditions_frozen.ADVANCE: bottle+cable 整体支持 trade-off 改善（至少一侧跑出 uniform-alpha frontier），且不存在严重跨类别反向恶化
exit_conditions_frozen.HOLD: 存在真实改善，但有轻度 category dependency，值得下一轮验证
exit_conditions_frozen.no_forced_winner: 如果 M7-M11 全部失败，明确输出 'Experiment 9B: no candidate promoted.'
